changes.change: Replaced pre-RFO 'DFARS 215.506-70 and 215.506' with RFO numbering: 'RFO DFARS 215.301-71 (enhanced postaward debriefing, was DFARS 215.506-70) and 215.301-70 (was DFARS 215.506), DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0048 Rev 1; RFO FAR 15.206-2 (preaward debriefing), 15.301-1 (postaward debriefing)'.
changes.reason: The RFO DFARS Part 215 deviation contains no 215.506; the keyed answer (two business days for written questions, five business days to answer, debriefing not concluded until the answers are delivered) is 215.301-71. CONTRACT.md section 8 requires RFO numbering with the old/new pair recorded.

changes.change: Correct option reworded from 'You may reject the bid as nonresponsive when the line item prices are materially unbalanced' to 'You may reject the bid when you determine that the lack of balance poses an unacceptable risk to the Government'; the why now states the risk test instead of the responsiveness label.
changes.reason: RFO FAR 14.306-3(g) (was 14.404-2(g), 'Rejection of individual bids - materially unbalanced') provides a discretionary rejection keyed to unacceptable risk. 'Nonresponsive' is GAO case-law shorthand and made the keyed option arguable. No distractor becomes defensible under the new wording.

changes.change: Stem changed from 'For DoD, progress payments based on a percentage or stage of completion are authorized for which contracts?' to 'Under the DFARS, progress payments based on a percentage or stage of completion are authorized on DoD contracts for which work?'. The why now names DFARS 232.102(e)(2). Cite changed from 'RFO FAR 32.103 (progress payments under construction contracts); FAR 32.102(b)' to 'RFO DFARS 232.102(e)(2) (DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0022); RFO FAR 32.102(e), 32.103'.
changes.reason: RFO FAR 32.102(e), fetched 14 Sep 2026, authorizes percentage or stage of completion progress payments for shipbuilding and ship conversion, alteration or repair AND for construction or architect-engineer services purchased under part 36. Under the FAR alone the keyed three-item answer is incomplete and the item ambiguous. The 'only for construction, shipbuilding, and ship conversion, alteration, or repair' restriction is the DoD rule at DFARS 232.102(e)(2) (recorded verified in src/data/regulations.json from Part 232 Class Deviation 2026-O0022). The old cites 32.102(b) and 32.103 did not support the keyed answer.

changes.change: Changed 'Official CORB board answer Q0075 (acceptance of a purchase order; legacy FAR 13.004)' to 'RFO FAR 12.201-1(b) (legal effect of quotations; was FAR 13.004(a)-(b)); official CORB board answer Q0075'.
changes.reason: The verified crosswalk maps FAR 13.004(a)(b) to FAR 12.201-1(b); the RFO Part 12 page fetched 14 Sep 2026 confirms a binding contract is formed by written acceptance of the purchase order or by substantial performance, which is the keyed answer.
